author: Linkle09
quote: I’ve been playing now for a good two days and I have the urge to just stop playing. The 30 fps makes the game unenjoyable for me since I’m normally playing games with 120+ fps. The graphics are the only good thing in this game yet I don’t get the hype behind extreme realism. I enjoy games with an unique artstyle that takes me away from reality. This game is doing the exact opposite. You have to play the loving husband and have to do chores. You can really feel who was in the development team. Generally the biggest embarrassment you could face as a gaming industry. 13 years for a bug filled game that runs on 30 fps on a 600$ console. Maybe the game will be more enjoyable once it releases on pc who knows but at this date this game is simply bad.
